newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds need to bust 109-24,25 to progress.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds need to bust 109-24,25 to progress.

text.p: June T-bond futures need to hurdle key resistance at 109-24/25 in order make a break for higher ground, analysts said on Friday.
April payroll data at 1230 GMT would curtail any early movement but would be key to further direction.
"It's quite simple," said Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here. "There is a colassal area of congestion on the charts at 109-18,24 and that's what we need to get through."
T-bonds were quoted at 109-22 at 1116 GMT, up 1/32 in automated trade.
The market hit a high of 109-25 in overnight trade, a level that has acted as resistance all week.
Resistance here also comes from the high on March 25, a level the market slid lower from in its latest downturn.
"If we can get through, we will target 110-03 and 110-14," Ostwald said. These were highs from the middle of March.
"That's where we rallied up to on this contract and never made it beyond there," Ostwald said.
Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch, said T-bonds saw a bit of hesitancy late on Thursday up around the 109-20 area.
"Everything is still quite strong. Daily studies are still in bull mode and so are candlestick charts although momentum has been waning in the last couple of sessions," he said.
He said he was looking for a push back up 110-03, the 50 percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from 113-25 to 106-12.
"I'm looking for some sort of top at or under 110-03," he said, adding that it was difficult to call the market before the payrolls data.

"If the figure is quite weak it will probably blast straight up through to a 62 percent retracement at 110-30. But for now we really need to see a correction of the the current rally from 106-30, the April 28 low," said Wilkin.
Wilkin said the market would initially pull back to the top of congestion between 108-07 and 107-28.
At the short end, September Eurodollars were at 93.885, unchanged on the day.
